reason: The validator covers 20 pure golden-string formatter ops (format_for_header, c_precedence_for_op, emit_const, CFlowEmitter::emit_*, CMacroExpander::expand, CIncludeManager, CStatement::render, CTypeDeclaration::emit_*, etc.). The MCP server exposes only one tool for this crate — `decompiler_core_batch_decompile` — which is a binary-address-driven batch orchestrator over the full decompile pipeline. None of the granular emitters validated by the Python golden tests are reachable via JSON-RPC. There is no input space on which the two surfaces can be compared.
gap_type: MCP surface gap — 19 granular formatter tools missing
recommendation: Wire the granular formatters from rustre-decompiler-c into rustre-mcp-tools (wire_tools.rs) as standalone MCP tools before this validator can run a behavioral comparison. This is a feature-add task, not a bug fix — out of scope for a single comparison turn.
